cases.name: Paula Marie Booth
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "She put herself through undergrad at Salem College and graduated in 2015. After graduating, she enrolled at Elon University Law School and graduated with the Class of December '17 - Elon’s first class to graduate from its accelerated 2.5 year program.  She passed the North Carolina Bar exam and worked as a Contracts Manager at Collins Aerospace in Winston Salem, North Carolina. She was highly respected and continuously praised for her hard work and determination. Marie was an outspoken advocate for women's empowerment and women’s rights, and frequently promoted self-worth.  Marie’s goals were focused on making a successful life for herself so she could provide a better life for her son Jacob, who is now 16 years old and in high school."
